1436-2085-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-2085-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

2023-4770-6723-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-728-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1170-2829-5131-7650--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-5131-7650--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Bilbo.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

1090-2350-6867-6967.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3240-6462-7422.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2092-4954-7288.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping the land and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.
2092-4954-7288.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

1477-1575-5903.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4365-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1069-2457-5499-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5499-7175.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5330-6972-7160.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-3301-3899-4552-6705.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

4508-5929-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-5929-6847.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Leyline of Transformation, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

24-1383-5644.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain twice that much life.

4067-5527-6100-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
4067-5527-6100-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Elvish Regrower.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Elvish Regrower that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Elvish Regrower token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Elvish Regrower from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

465-1251-3742-4251-5929.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3719-4893-5326-5361.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3719-4893-5326-5361.notablePrerequisites: Auton Soldier has a power of at least 2.
3719-4893-5326-5361.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Auton Soldier and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Auton Soldier to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Auton Soldier by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

774-2653-5233.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

573-1741-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
573-1741-5900.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gruul Turf and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.

1165-2736-2861.notablePrerequisites: Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
1165-2736-2861.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Archfiend of the Dross to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

1849-4499-4747.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

2573-3946-5450.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

222-4647-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling, and at least one additional nontoken creature.
222-4647-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creatures' powers.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

969-1550-4251.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any Samurai you control.
Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached cannot be blocked by an opponent.
969-1550-4251.description:
Declare Godo and the Samurai with Sword of Hearth and Home attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, untapping it and all Samurai you control, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Godo and the Samurai that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Godo, then search your library for a basic land card and exile it, then put the land and Godo from exile onto the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House

1432-1434-4284.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
1432-1434-4284.description:
Activate Clone's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature you control.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Clone and another legendary creature you control.
Repeat.

132-198-549-800.notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-198-549-800.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {U} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Knacksaw Clique's ability by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, causing target opponent to exile the top card of their library, and allowing you to play that card this turn.
Repeat.

2781-4249-4499.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six devotion to any color.
2781-4249-4499.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Nykthos.
Repeat.

890-1283-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Palladium Myr.
Palladium Myr does not have summoning sickness.
890-1283-4222.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Palladium Myr.
Repeat.

3765-3937.manaNeeded: {8}{B}{R}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3765-3937.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Cast Mogis from the command zone by paying {2}{B}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
At the beginning of an opponent's upkeep, Mogis triggers, dealing 2 damage to them as they are unable to sacrifice a creature.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining opponent.

1376-1978-5056.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
1376-1978-5056.description:
Cause Priest of Titania to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat from step 2.

913-2440-4770.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Cat creatures.
913-2440-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Whitemane Lion's trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may activate Signpost Scarecrow any number of times.
